guardrails: For each of 19 remaining, first establish identity or actual batch-specific formula, not broad category name alone.
Special schedules/appendices are broad categories, not specific chemical monographs: require exact ingredient name and INS/CAS/EC where appropriate.
Some CTR IX commodity entries govern raw foods, not changed processed analytical matrices. Verify any permitted processing factor and relevant sample basis.
No product compliance approval without current named source, other CTR/addivitive/microbiological/residue rules and lot evidence.
